definition: flat, with no part higher or lower
description: A young man in a paint-spattered t-shirt is decorating a bare white wall in a flat with a wooden floor. He holds a black-framed picture up against the wall and shifts it until it sits straight, then lays a yellow spirit level along the top edge of a framed flower painting and watches the bubble. He hangs a striped woven textile beside the frames, adds two wooden shelves with potted plants and a decorative leaf clock, and by the end the whole wall is a dense gallery of aligned frames. A step ladder stands to one side and he steps back, hands on hips, to look at the finished wall.

taps.phrase: to rest against a picture frame
